baseline.prior_season_fallback: 2026 scheme/true-pressure uses latest available <=2025, marked STALE_PRIOR_SEASON_FALLBACK; FTN current prior games when present; missing evidence yields neutral feature, never synthetic labels

bootstrap.confidence: percentile 95% CI; secondary descriptive, no multiple-comparison-adjusted certainty claim
bootstrap.unit: whole games clustered in consecutive 2-week blocks within season; paired loss differences, circular moving blocks, 2000 resamples, seed=164; no player-row resampling

cutoff: Strictly earlier REG season/week AND earlier game date. No target-week plays, labels, participation, FTN, roster evidence in efficiency features. Skill follows GSIS identity. Phase1E opportunity is frozen comparator with its existing T90 roster assumption, not a new availability model.

depth_explosive.mechanism: Target depth/deep exposure and opponent completed deep-air suppression alter completed air per catch only. Air20 explicitly excludes YAC; total 20+ reception rate retained in receipt only.

man_zone.mechanism: Opponent man propensity vs receiver historical man/zone mix interacts with shrunken receiver conditional catch/air splits. No final-yard split.

pressure_blitz.mechanism: Pressure/blitz can disrupt catch conversion; shrink receiver pressured-vs-clean catch gap. No air/YAC/final-yard routing.

yac_matchup.mechanism: Opponent position-specific YAC containment and after-catch explosives interact with receiver YAC profile; YAC only.

fitting.combinations: Only families that pass independent development gate; fixed sum of their preselected component corrections, common adjustment bounds, all subsets of size>=2. No new fit/retune. Select simpler on ties.
fitting.learner: Offset binomial logistic ridge for catch; weighted ridge residual for conditional air/YAC; no intercept, no generic calibration or final-yard regression. Train-only weighted RMS scaling, absent features=0, no feature fishing. Catch weights=actual targets, conditional weights=actual catches.

gates.family_development: >=0.5% oracle-yard MAE gain vs mechanical R0; YPT no worse; every routed claimed component >=0.5% gain vs R0 (catch_rate, conditional_air_per_catch, conditional_yac_per_catch as appropriate); paired block-bootstrap oracle delta 95% upper<0
gates.full_yards: Only if selected efficiency passes 2025 independently: use frozen Phase1E targets then report MAE, within10/20, >40, signed bias; otherwise NOT_RUN_EFFICIENCY_GATE_FAILED (receipt arithmetic remains available, not scored).
gates.select_overall: Development candidate must additionally beat incumbent Phase1F and simple history oracle MAE by >=0.5%, YPT no worse; choose lowest oracle MAE then simpler then deterministic name.
gates.validation: Same practical oracle/YPT/component requirements on 2025, bootstrap upper<0 vs incumbent; no new combination/penalty after validation. Validation failure frozen. 2026 does not rescue.

population: Phase1B fixed_meaningful_rows rec_yds: prior 3 current-team games, >=2 games and mean targets >=3; same paired rows for every architecture. Actual-target >0 only for efficiency; zero-target meaningful rows remain in full evaluation.
source_vintage_limit: Retrospective releases are not archived historical provider snapshots. Completed-game label history is tested; no claim these files prove literal historical T24/T90 availability. Injury date_modified is not proof of original pregame publication; absence features BLOCKED_DATA.
